Every single member of Finn Partners has a stake in the success of our business, and this directly translates to the success of our clients. We are extremely proud of the team we have brought together and the work we do. We call ourselves “citizens of the world.” Our team members share a drive to excel and give back, to achieve more than the job calls for. Above all, we share a passion for delivering great results that make a difference in the world. Of course, we have a lot of fun along the way!

If you share these ideals, Finn Partners could be the right place for you. We are actively recruiting at all levels in all markets. Please reach out to and let us know why you want to join us.

## Media Planner, Performance, (Paid Media Executive)

London, United Kingdom

Full Time

Mid Level

[Share](https://joinus.applytojob.com/app/share/XISKZfAGUe)

About FINN Partners

FINN Partners is a fast-growing, global independent marketing agency recognised for its bold ideas and collaborative spirit. Our expertise spans integrated marketing, media, and creative services, offering clients a unified team focused on business and brand growth. The Performance Media team leads performance strategy across paid search, social, programmatic, and audience insights, while the Brand Media team leads brand strategy across narrative and channel selection. The two teams build every media plan together, aligned to a single business outcome. Media joins client engagements at the earliest stages, working alongside strategy and creative to develop one integrated campaign. As the team grows, we're looking for a Media Planner ready to build hands-on performance media expertise across paid search, paid social, and programmatic.

**More about the role**

As a Media Planner, Performance, you will strive to understand your clients' businesses and any challenges they face. You’ll drum up new ways to help them drive their business forward.

You'll work on building paid advertising campaigns on Meta, Google, TikTok, display platforms, and other social platforms.

You’ll be responsible for planning & building campaigns for our clients with the support of our in-house Paid Media team, whether that’s driving conversions or launching awareness campaigns.

Your daily tasks include media planning, ad-buying, optimizing performance, and reporting.

**What you'll do**

- Participate in the development of integrated media plans and strategies
- Oversee end-to-end management of media campaigns
- Implement and monitor tracking of KPIs and overall ROI
- Execute a wide variety of online media (including display, video, paid social, and PPC)
- Construct and deliver detailed reports every month
- Conduct industry, competitive, and audience research using media tools and agency resources
- Daily pacing and budget tracking
- Stay up-to-date with media trends and best practices
- Learn the latest media platforms/tools

**Experience that contributes to success**

- G Suite (sheets, docs, slides), Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel)
- Self-serve social media platforms (Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Snapchat, TikTok)
- Google Marketing Platform (Campaign Manager, Google Analytics, Google Data Studio)
- Ability to conduct critical analysis and identify key insights
- Strong written, verbal, and visual communication skills
- Proactive and self-motivated
- Excellent problem-solving skills
- Paid media experience in a agency or in-house enviroment
- Solid project management and organisational skills
- High level of accuracy and attention to detail
- Ability to multitask, prioritize, and perform under tight deadlines
- Proficiency with FINN's reporting and dashboard platforms, including Ninjacat and Funnel, or similar tools
- Familiarity with AI tools used across the agency, including Gemini, OpenAI, Copilot, and Claude, to support planning, research, and reporting workflows

**FINN's promise to You!**

At **FINN Partners,** we believe our strength comes from our people and the perspectives they bring. As a global, independent agency built on collaboration and entrepreneurship, we know that creativity and communications thrive when informed by diverse experiences, backgrounds, and ideas!

We are committed to building teams that reflect the world we live in and the audiences we serve. By bringing together talented individuals with different viewpoints, we are better equipped to deliver bold thinking, foster meaningful connections, and create impactful work for our clients. Your unique perspective is not only valued - it’s essential to how we innovate and succeed together.

We also believe that great work happens through connection and collaboration. Our teams operate in a hybrid environment that supports in-person collaboration alongside flexibility. We encourage open conversations around individual needs and are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process and beyond

**Where You’ll Work**

We're a remote-first workplace, with optional in-office days available at our London office.

**How To Apply**

Please upload your resume and cover letter, as well as indicate your desired salary.

While we appreciate the interest of all candidates, we will only respond to those with whom we have a greater interest.
